# Security Policy

## 🐞 Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub Issues.**

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately via email: **info@samuel-steiner.com**

## 📌 Supported Versions

We actively support the **latest stable versions of PHP** and all dependencies.  
Please ensure that your reports target these versions.

## ⏱️ Response

I aim to respond as soon as possible on a best-effort basis.
